## Why This Is Asked
This tests practical pipeline security for multi-account deployments, focusing on identity, secrets, and IR.

- GitHub Actions OIDC integration
- Per-environment IAM roles and least privilege
- AWS Secrets Manager for API keys
- CI secret scanning

``` javascript
name: Deploy-prod
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v3
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ProdDeployRole
          aws-region: us-west-2
      - run: npm ci && npm run deploy
      - name: Run secret scan
        run: echo 'Secret scan would run here (tool config)'
```

## Follow-up Questions
- Which secret-scanning tools would you deploy and why?
- How would you handle rotation and revocation of leaked credentials in prod?

import hmac, hashlib, time

## Why This Is Asked

- Real-time event bus, multi-tenant isolation, per-tenant credentials
- Event signing, replay protection, nonce handling
- ABAC/OPA policy enforcement, ephemeral credentials, CI gates
- Observability and IR/DR playbooks

## Code Example
```javascript
// Example: verify event signature (pseudo)
function verifyEvent(event, signature, key) {
  const crypto = require('crypto')
  const h = crypto.createHmac('SHA256', key)
  h.update(JSON.stringify(event))
  return h.digest('hex') === signature
}
```
